tools.name: resolve_destination
tools.description:
Resolve a city, country, region, or airport onto Sorted destinations.

Use this when the traveler names a place and you do not already have a
sitemap handle (paris, hanoi) or IATA code. Returns handle, name,
country, airport_code, and place_url for a few live matches. After
resolve: for generic info

tools.name: get_recommended_destinations
tools.description:
Recommend destinations from a departure airport.

Use this whenever the traveler asks where to go. Only set filter
arguments they explicitly asked for (month, airport, budget, weather,
visa, tags). Omit all other filters so Sorted keeps its defaults. Never
set a filter to false just because they did

tools.name: render_recommended_destinations
tools.description:
Render the destination recommendations carousel.

Always call get_recommended_destinations first for a new search, then
pass its destinations (and related fields) here. For a follow-up that
narrows an existing list, call only this tool with the filtered
destinations. Do not invent destination cards.

tools.name: render_destination_info
tools.description:
Render the destination facts card.

Always call get_destination_info first, then pass its structuredContent
here. Do not invent destination facts.

tools.description:

tools.name: update_profile_preferences
tools.description:
Update one saved traveler profile preference for the signed-in user.

Requires an OAuth 2.0 access token with the profile.write scope. Allowed
fields: currency, units, sourceAirportCode, passports, visas,
passportHolder, airlines, destinationInterests, activityInterests,

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_recommended_destinations" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_recommended_destinations, get_profile_preferences, update_profile_preferences · Private data: get_profile_preferences, update_profile_preferences · Public sink: get_destination_info, get_destination_weather, update_profile_preferences · Destructive: update_profile_preferences.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_recommended_destinations, get_profile_preferences, update_profile_preferences · Private data: get_profile_preferences, update_profile_preferences · Public sink: get_destination_info, get_destination_weather, update_profile_preferences · Destructive: update_profile_preferences

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
